design.name: 冰甲刀卒
design.brief: The basic foot soldier of the frozen legion, attacking in squads: a stocky Tang infantryman in frost-crusted lacquer-red lamellar armour over a padded coat, a round iron helmet with a red tassel and a fierce iron face mask with two glowing cyan eye slits, a cracked bronze heart-protector mirror (护心镜) on the chest glowing cyan through the cracks (weak spot), fur cuffs, wrapped shins and sturdy boots. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers.
design.weapon: a single Tang straight sabre (横刀) raised for a leaping overhead slash
design.style_note: Style target: the enemies of Gunfire Reborn — a readable military unit roster where every troop type is told apart at 30 m by silhouette and weapon. Strongly stylized, chunky and exaggerated: big helmets and pauldrons, oversized hands and weapons, compact sturdy bodies, faces hidden behind iron masks with two glowing cyan eye slits, bold saturated colour blocks (lacquer red, dark iron, bronze, white fur, cyan glow), clean bevelled forms, armour plates as a few big shapes, no tiny detail noise. Menacing and cool, not cute.
